name: Asset Class Taxonomy -- ONE canonical five-class asset-class taxonomy (Fixed Income/Cash, Equity, Structured, Commodities, Alternatives), sorted from a single source (ETFClassifier) and rendered consistently across the two Positioning surfaces: the Positioning view and the combined Philosophy/Capital-Market-Assumptions view.
description: The five-class taxonomy that replaces the old scheme: volatility/hedge broken out of Equity into Structured (the Cottonwood catalyst) and gold/commodities into Commodities. FWD-1..FWD-6 confirmed by Andrew 2026-09-11 (five classes in canonical order with colors; one central source that flows; the two surfaces agree). Owns the class definitions (identity/order/color), the single classification, and the requirement that every surface reads that one classification rather than re-deriving it. Relies on -- does not own -- the holdings, the surfaces' broader content, and the ETF/holdings data.
